input.detail:
Fixed 3 anti-patterns in game-engine zone:

1. **Zone/filesystem alignment**: Reclassified board-utils.ts and canvas-drawing.ts from game-engine to world-inventory-ui in zones.json, aligning zone membership with their physical location in app/components/.

2. **Eliminated DAG-bypass**: Created app/geometry/rainbow-arc.ts as a dedicated shared geometry layer. Moved all 7 SVG constants from engine/rainbow-constants.ts to this new module. Deleted the old engine file and removed its re-exports from the engine barrel. Both hooks and components now import from ~/geometry/rainbow-arc without any layering workaround.

3. **Extracted presentation math from hook**: Extracted computeArcProgress() function into the new geometry module. useRainbowEasterEgg no longer computes pixel-level arc geometry — it delegates to computeArcProgress() and only manages interaction state (progress, potRevealed, unlocked) and easter-egg unlock logic.

All 119 tests pass. No lint errors. TypeScript clean.
